text: **Cursebound 1** You gain weakness 2 to fire damage. text: You gain electricity weakness 2 and electricity spells or effects that have additional effects for a creature wearing or holding metal treat you as though you were wearing metal. name: Curse of the Mortal Warrior
text: You smell faintly of steel and blood no matter how you try to remove or mask the scent, you appear more imposing and muscular than you actually are, and you hear the faint clash and clamor of battle in the distance at all times. name: Gate Junction
text: - An **elemental resistance** grants you resistance to damage while your kinetic aura is active. You can voluntarily forgo this resistance, immunity, or both if you want an effect to work on you.

text: Constructs and objects are not immune to this spirit damage, and this spirit damage automatically bypasses an amount of their Hardness equal to your level.

name: Toxicologist
text: Your infused items with the poison trait can affect creatures immune to poison. A creature takes acid damage instead of poison damage from such items if either the creature is immune to poison or that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM). You gain poison resistance equal to half your level.

name: Cry Havoc!
text: All squadmates can Stride up to twice their Speed directly toward the target as a reaction, yelling and trampling. Regardless of the outcome, the enemy is then temporarily immune to any further damage from Cry Havoc! for 24 hours.

name: Sanguine Revitalization
text: Those allies can Stride up to half their Speed as a free action. Once all Strikes are completed, if the target took damage and is not immune to bleed damage, it must succeed at a saving throw against your class DC or take 10 points of persistent bleed damage.

name: Brandish the Gorgon's Gaze
text: Regardless of the outcome, that creature is temporarily immune to this effect for 24 hours.

name: Break the Sun's Legs
text: The stolen light is channeled to your eyes, granting you greater darkvision for the duration of the effect.

name: Skirt the Underworld
text: You skirt into the world of the dead, becoming invisible for 1 round, then Fly up to your Speed. Undead and other creatures with strong ties to the world of the dead, such as psychopomps, are immune to this effect.

name: Tangle in Riddle
text: It's then immune to this ability for 1 hour.

name: Grim Swagger
text: Regardless of whether you succeed or fail, each subject is temporarily immune to your Grim Swagger for 10 minutes.

name: Nudging Whisper
text: If you critically fail at either check, the target and anyone who witnessed you fail becomes immune to your Nudging Whisper for one day, though this doesn't necessarily let them know that you attempted to charm them.

name: Inspired Stratagem
text: That ally then becomes temporarily immune to your Inspired Stratagem until your next daily preparations.

name: Glimpse Vulnerability
text: Until you Glimpse Vulnerability again, that target gains weakness 2 against your unarmed and weapon Strikes.

name: Lucky Coin
text: Either way, you're temporarily immune to Guarded Fortune for 1 hour.

name: Lucky Coin (Lucky Copper)
text: Either way, you're temporarily immune to Guarded Fortune for 1 hour.

name: Lucky Coin (Lucky Silver)
text: Either way, you're temporarily immune to Guarded Fortune for 1 hour.

name: Lucky Coin (Lucky Gold)
text: Either way, you're temporarily immune to Guarded Fortune for 1 hour.

name: The Eye of the Slumberer
text: Each time a creature with the aquatic, amphibious, or water trait falls asleep or otherwise passes the night within 1 mile of the *Eye of the Slumberer*, it dreams fitfully of the artifact; creatures that don't dream are immune to this effect.

name: Winged Terror
text: The wearer gains resistance 5 to physical damage dealt by frightened creatures.

name: Coral Aspect
text: Allies that share your space gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC, and you gain resistance 5 to any damage caused by a creature sharing the same space as you.
